title: ActiveEntitlement
description: An active entitlement describes access to a feature for a customer.

feature.description: The [Feature](https://docs.stripe.com/api/entitlements/feature) that the customer is entitled to.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

lookup_key.description: A unique key you provide as your own system identifier. This may be up to 80 characters.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
